description: Full circular visualization composed of concentric annular bands and a central circular glyph. Layout is purely radial with multiple rings of small arc-like cells and a central scatter of circles.

components.description: Central circular region containing many small dots scattered across angles and radii within the inner disk.

Narrow annulus immediately outside the inner scatter. Contains short-bar arc segments concentrated in a limited angular sector along the right side; bars extend slightly radially outward forming a small stacked/clustered set.
Outer annular band with larger set of arc cells arranged in rows around the circle; denser at lower-left quadrant with darker fills and scattered lighter cells elsewhere.

primary.explanation: Many small dots scattered across radius and angle within the inner disk; scatter points use polar position.
Eighteen angle groups, each containing three radial segments.
Outer annulus is split into several concentric rows; about six are visible.

secondary.explanation: Each row is divided into many equal angular cells around the full circle.
